description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Stunning Home!* Recently expanded with 900 square feet of newly renovated living space* Private Pool * Gulfview Heights Beach Access 350yds Away* Balcony overlooking Pool* 4 Fun Pug Bikes Included* Snorkel the Seahorse Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Walk to Goatfeathers Rest., Local Catch Bar and Grill + local shops* 0.7 miles to Gulf Place: Perfect Pig, Shunk Gulley, and more* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is not available to adults under the age of 25. No Exceptions. *Welcome to Jini Jim Jams, a charming three-bedroom, three-bathroom private cottage designed for relaxation and easy coastal living. Tucked away in the peaceful Gulfview Heights neighborhood, this inviting retreat is just a short stroll from the sugar-white sands and emerald waters of the Gulf, making it an ideal beach getaway. Recently renovated with an additional 900 square feet of living space, the home offers plenty of room for everyone to spread out and unwind.The fully equipped kitchen features ample counter space, perfect for preparing meals and gathering with family and friends. Upstairs, you’ll find a spacious king master suite, a comfortable guest queen bedroom, and a guest room with a twin-over-queen bunk. The first floor includes a sleeper sofa, allowing the home to accommodate up to 9 guests comfortably. Step outside to enjoy grilling and dining on the expansive patio or spend your days lounging by the pool. Jini Jim Jams is the perfect place to relax, recharge, and create lasting beach memories.The Bed Setup:1st FloorLiving Room: Sleeper Sofa2nd FloorMaster Bedroom 1: King BedGuest Bedroom: Queen BedGuest Bedroom: Twin-over-Queen Bunk BedArea Attractions: Jini Jim Jams is perfectly situated, with Grayton Beach, Seaside, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach just minutes away from the East. Located in an upscale area of Hwy 30A, this pristine house is perched between Destin and Seaside. Just a 13-minute drive to Grand Boulevard Town Center with over 35 shops and restaurants, as well as the all-new state-of-the-art Boulevard 10 Movie Theater. Bike down to Blue Mountain Creamery for a cone or meander along the miles of trails! The Gulf Place community is located along a 26-mile stretch of sugar-white sand and turquoise waters of Northwest Florida’s celebrated Emerald Coast. As one of the 16 distinct beach neighborhoods in South Walton, it has its own distinct character and charm. This colorful community on 30A comprises 25 acres located in the heart of Santa Rosa Beach on the corner of 30A and 393. Gulf Place was specifically designed to slow visitors and locals down with palm tree-lined streets, wide sidewalks, colorful outdoor patios with large umbrellas, nature walking trails, green spaces, and ample park benches to sit and enjoy the views. Gulf Place is unique among all the other South Walton neighborhoods. Residents and guests gather here to enjoy original art, boutique shopping, local cuisine, live music, and a laid-back atmosphere. 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, and tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Seahorse Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 715 feet out from the Topsail Hill Preserve State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Seahorse Reef is at a depth of 13-18 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
